goal: Conduct a systematic forensic audit of the identified textual discrepancies by comparing the "Original Record" (baseline) against the King James Version (KJV) and historical manuscript traditions.
notes: The audit will be conducted in phases to ensure precision.
Each phase will involve searching for specific verses and linguistic patterns.
The final output will be a report summarizing the findings (Confirmed, Disproven, or Ambiguous).
